title: Sugar Factory Zeeland
scope: The standing De Zeeland former sugar factory on Markiezaatsweg in Bergen op Zoom. Includes its three industrial halls, low links and measured retail-era external additions.
limitations: The model depicts the standing factory halls and measured exterior volumes. Detailed current shopfront designs, signage, service fixtures and interiors are outside scope.
The cleared photograph predates the recent conversion. Historic façade openings are retained with representative reopened glazing, and shop entrances and unseen details use bounded estimates.
